name: Skuzzys Sparktacular Backgrounds
description:
Would you rather have some new Backgrounds? Or new Frames? How about... BOTH! (tm). Enjoy the sparkliest set of Hunnys Closet items to hit the shelves since the Skuzzy Sparkle Skin & Dye Set! 



This Pack is once again brought to you in collaboration with our dearly beloved [Skuzzrat](https://buy.hunnys.io/portfolio/0x6c6cD01ebbd02254C5Db5263797E366511992d29?tab=items), the cutiest, sparkliest, happee-est stinker on the streets!




Owning this v loud Pack brings you the following set of backgrounds & frames that will make ur heart sing love songs, and setting the ultimate stage for a night of dress-up:

Background: Skuzzys Sekret Space Zone 1

Background: Skuzzys Sekret Space Zone 2

Background: Skuzzys Sekret Space Zone 3

Background: Skuzzys Sekret Space Zone 4

Background: Skuzzy Sticker Maddness

Background: 90s Laser

Background: Twinkle Vines

Background: Twinkling Vines Night

Background: Evergreen Scene

Frame: Soft Snow

Frame: Love Bunnys

Frame: Fuzzle Toe

Frame: Stabby Skuzzcicles 1

Eyes: Stabby Skuzzcicles 2
\n


All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).



As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io), it will automatically be available for use - enjoy, and say CHEESE!
